title: Figure 31: Commercial lab-chip devices for on-chip electrophoresis biomarker analysis
description: Collage of manufacturer images of lab-on-a-chip products, including a NanoChip 400 cartridge (nanogen.com), an Affymetrix chip, a Caliper Technologies microfluidic chip beside a coin, and an Aclara Biosciences electrophoresis trace panel. Caption reads "Figure 31. Commercial Lab-Chip Devices That Allow Analysis for Biomarkers of Various Diseases Using on-Chip Electrophoresis in Microscale (collage from manufacturers listed)."
